reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in our DM. I told them I'd keep the unconfirmed Bay 35 site change for the Tansley Parcel depot private, and that I'd help announce it if it gets confirmed. I didn't post it in any channel, message anyone else, or save it to GBrain or memory.

GBrain only had the incident chat from the carrier API outage on 2025-09-03, which says label printing stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots. It had nothing on a site change. Its search ran in keyword-only mode, so that doesn't prove there's nothing there.
